name: ADITYA BIRLA LIFES BRAN L
summary: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited engages in the retail of garments and accessories in India and internationally. The company is also involved in the western wear business under the lifestyle brands, including Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, and Peter England brands; the sportswear business under the Reebok brand; and the innerwear business under the Van Heusen brand, as well as offers youth wear under the American Eagle brand. It also operates a chain of apparel and accessories retail stores. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
